title: Metallic Gloves
summary: Medium Armour gloves that grant +1 to Strength saving throws.

fields.Bonus: +1 to Strength saves while equipped. Medium Armour proficiency.
fields.Variants: The vendor and Temple Cave appearances share the same bonus. Dammon and Roah Moonglow sell the vendor version. The cave version is beneath the Open Hand Temple, X 62, Y −1021.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
